說明: 《千秋硯》卷三〈阿瑪納〉生圖清單（回一～回五）。畫風、節點、尺寸沿用卷一清單。注意：阿頓與阿蒙都不醜化，妖物是人心所化、不是神本身；建築依阿瑪納的考古復原（白色泥磚、平屋頂），不要金字塔與獅身人面像。

items.name: 阿肯塔頓
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, the new city of Akhetaten (Amarna) on the east bank of the Nile in Middle Egypt: a city being built in the desert under a blazing white midday sun: rows of new whitewashed mud-brick walls rising from the sand, workers carrying small stone blocks on their shoulders, wooden scaffolds and ropes, a wide shining river to the west lined with a narrow strip of brilliant green fields and palm trees, a long line of pale yellow cliffs to the east, a huge open-air temple of many courtyards without roofs in the distance. Architecture as in archaeological reconstructions of Amarna: flat-roofed buildings of sun-dried mud brick plastered and whitewashed, simple rectangular shapes, wooden doors, palm-trunk beams; people wear plain white linen kilts and simple linen dresses, men with short-cropped hair, bare feet or reed sandals. No pyramids, no sphinx, no camels, no domes, no arches, no minarets.

Any carved signs are Egyptian hieroglyph pictures (small birds, eyes, reeds, water lines, human figures) worn and blurred; absolutely no Chinese characters, no Asian script, no Latin letters.

items.name: 暈船
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, on a wooden Nile boat under a tall linen sail, exactly four figures, two male and two female. In the centre, clearly a GIRL: a 15-year-old Egyptian girl with a soft feminine face, short black hair under a plain white linen headscarf, a long white linen dress, a smear of red ochre on one cheek and green malachite on the other, a reed pen tucked behind her ear, laughing at the youth while holding a flat white limestone flake.
